programme.title: Coffin Homes
programme.desc: Three tales merges in this satire set against Hong Kong's housing crisis, where soaring property prices have driven people to desperate measures - including sharing a space with the dead!

programme.title: To Live And Die in Mongkok
programme.desc: Disoriented and trapped in notorious, vice-ridden Mongkok, a once-feared triad figure struggles to adapt to life in the wake of his 30-year prison sentence.

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: A crooked watch dealer gathers a team of thieves to steal three luxury watches in Tokyo. Their plan alters upon finding the legendary 'Moonwatch', leading to a perilous heist amidst a yakuza pursuit.

programme.title: I Believe
programme.desc: Chu Chu waits 10 years for her first love, who marries another. Losing faith, she meets a wedding planner and a wealthy man, both offering solace. Torn between them, who will she choose in the end?

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved!

programme.title: All U Need is Love
programme.desc: When a luxury hotel in Hong Kong suddenly becomes a Coronavirus superspreader, guests & the staff are faced with a 14-day trial they may not survive.

programme.title: Shining for One Thing
programme.desc: Zhang Wan Sen plans to confess his crush on Lin Bei Xing after the exam. When an accident changes everything tragically, Zhang travels back in time. Can he amend things this time?

programme.title: Death Stranding
programme.desc: The Police and gambling association team up to overhaul underground gambling by auctioning new casino licenses. This unveils the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: Love is Blind, Hate Too
programme.desc: A year ago, Bo became blind in a serious car accident. One day, an intruder enters her house and takes her hostage. As she tries to survive, she discovers her husband's involvement in her accident!

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: After accidentally killing veteran detective Zhan's wife, Wang Tao seeks redemption by assisting Zhan in tracking a serial killer. However, her involvement puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: From Vegas to Macau 3
programme.desc: The latest sequel to the action-comedy FROM VEGAS to MACAU brings Andy Lau & Jacky Cheung back in a power-packed new tale.

programme.title: Endless Battle
programme.desc: Two brothers, a drug lord and a police officer, are involved in a drug cartel's turf battle. After the younger brother's hidden identity as a drug lord is unveiled, an endless battle begins.

programme.title: Legally Declared Dead
programme.desc: An insurance agent who finds his clients' son dead in their bathroom begins to suspect that the parents may have something to hide.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, the murder of a white woman in Chinatown ignites public outrage. Two Chinese detectives race against time to uncover the true killer amid mounting tension and danger.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: After a security engineer unwittingly becomes involved in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Fei meets young talent Wai who suffers from a rare disease, and helps Wai find his lost love. Even when they know the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: I Did it My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive dark world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and secret operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: The Calling of a Bus Driver
programme.desc: Based on a true story, a girl named Suki aspire to fulfill her dream after leaving with her cheating boyfriend. Later, when invited to attend his wedding, she schemes to have her revenge.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Framed and forced to leave all he loves, a grocery clerk ultimately grows into one of Shanghai's most powerful mob bosses. Yet, can he leave the past behind?

programme.title: Love After Love

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates a fatal explosion involving two women who look alike. As he delves deeper, Wei unveils a web of deceit as details from the past and present come together in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Vanguard

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: This epic depicts the romance between the Jade Emperor's seventh daughter and a young village man. When Heaven and Earth meet, can a common ground be found?

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: The peaceful life of Golden Swallow is shattered when her unrequited suitor, Silver Roc, begins a killing spree to draw her out of seclusion. Stars Cheng Pei Pei, Jimmy Wang Yu.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: Based on a famed Chinese opera, this melodramatic film depicts the romance between Zhang Sheng, an impoverished scholar, and Ying Ying, who is from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Lady of the Law
programme.desc: One of director Shen Chiang's last works, this action-packed adventure features a lone female fighter, decades before the dawn of pro-feminist kung fu films.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: A woman gets involved in a Ching Dynasty salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and dilemmas gone rotten.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: From writer director Pan Lei comes this Chinese variation of Henry King's famous 1950's film about a persecuted swordsman.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Follow a virtuous viper as it sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a dangerous lady in this thriller!

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu, who is trying to shed his criminal side, instead finds himself caught up in an all-out gang war that comes to a startling conclusion.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: Starring Kara Hui, Yuen Tak and Meng Yuen Man, this film depicts a series of battles as everyone fights over the 'Yuan Yang Swords', which hold the secrets to Kung Fu.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: The Shaw Brothers' directors created this 60's classic depicting a timeless romance between a wealthy man and a songbird.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: This wuxia film's swordsman hero must go against many treacherous warriors to solve the murder of three clan heads.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu Lan
programme.desc: A young woman joins the army in place of her old, ailing father and only when she returns home is the truth revealed.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: Director Ho Meng-hua presents an all-star cast in this searing martial arts extravaganza that will bewitch you with its swift swordplay.

programme.title: Inside the Forbidden City
programme.desc: This film marks the Shaw Brothers' quintessential 'Huangmei Opera' costume drama, with a superb performance from Ivy Ling Po and Chin Feng.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: It's Shaolin versus corrupt Ching soldiers in Chang Cheh's fun-filled kung-fu showcase, filled with show-stopping martial arts sequences.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: When deadbeats Ming and Liang stumble upon records of scandals involving government officials, what follows is a humorous misadventure of epic proportions.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The 'iron triangle' comprising director Chang Cheh and stars David Chiang and Ti Lung produces this explosive kung fu epic.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: An emperor's obsession with his consort distracts him, allowing his cruel prime minister who also happens to be his consort's brother, to run the nation.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaw's Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaire's daughter.

programme.title: Men From the Gutter
programme.desc: From its evocative title to its gritty filming and gutsy plot, this sizzling crime thriller strikes a chord with audience round the world.

programme.title: Illicit Desire

programme.title: Crazy Nuts of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home when they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign.

programme.title: Moods of Love
programme.desc: How far would you go for love? Or lust? These are the questions posed in two, sinfully entertaining Sung Dynasty tales that comprise this film.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: This compelling Shaw Brothers Huangmei Opera depicts the romance of star-crossed lovers the son of a respected government official and a famed prostitute.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei turns human combine harvester as she hacks a path through life, avenging the death of her family under the moniker 'The Jade Raksha'.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: Two students fall in love but their two families are enemies and separated by a river that is filled with crocodiles and beasts.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: Directed by Chang cheh, this kung fu film is one of the final efforts in the 'Venoms'' genre. It features a main character who is mistaken for a clan leader.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: A follow-up to the previous blockbuster, this 60's musical features an unemployed magician whose love life is as twisted as his tricks.

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt official's obsessive bid to find a hidden treasure leads him to jail and torture his daughter's lover, and bury her alive!

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: This comedy centres on the residents of a females-only apartment who hail from different backgrounds and make money in varied ways.

programme.title: Opium and the Kung-Fu Master

programme.title: Party Tricks
programme.desc: Laura's got tricks up her sleeve. First, she enlists some help to make kombucha's cousin, kompot. Next, it's feel good treats for your pup. And finally - a yacht party! But not that kind - we mean the band YACHT! Enjoy.

programme.title: The Great Outdoors
programme.desc: Laura teams up with Mia & Pascal for a foraging adventure and outdoor meal. Then, we learn which veggies and spices make the best dyes. Finally, you can never have too many tomatoes! Soup, salad and a perfect Bloody Mary blend are in your future.

programme.title: Fab Friends
programme.desc: Surprise! Laura is equally crafty when it comes to woodwork. Then, fabulous recipes & a backyard brunch to knock your friend's socks off! Finally, Laura visits ceramicist Georgia Hodges at her studio in SF, and together, they create a unique piece.

programme.title: One Tray Bake and Hangry Hacks
programme.desc: Nic and Ian cook up a one pot wonder meal that’s simple, delicious and easy. Then they battle the hanger by cooking up some snacks which will keep your kids full and satisfied; featuring special guest, Charlotte Stirling Reed.

programme.title: Food for Thought and the Proof is in the Pudding
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll be exploring the foods that feed the belly and fuel the brain! Nic and Ian cook up some sweet treats that’ll perk up anyone’s school night dinner! Featuring guest chef, Selasi Gbormittah.

programme.title: Grandma Estelle
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith’s grandma inspired him in life and in the kitchen. He shares family recipes taking him right back to grandma's table. He's cookin' up Fried Chicken, Mac ‘N Cheese, Collard Green Slaw, Brûlée Banana Pudding and Pop-pops moonshine.

programme.title: Dinner Party
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith is hosting a dinner party! Living in KoreaTown, Derrell has fallen in love with its food and culture. Tonight, he's servin' up Braised Beef Short Rib with Crispy Rice Cakes, Pickled Cabbage, Glass Noodles Salad and Korean Pancakes.

programme.title: How Do You Like Them Apples
programme.desc: Apples aren’t just good for keeping the doctor away. Frankie demonstrates how to make the most of this beloved, everyday fruit, from sweet treats to savory meals. There’s a whole world of apples to dive into, especially while they’re in season.

programme.title: The Future is Flavor
programme.desc: Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that’ll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.

programme.title: Summer Surf 'n' Turf
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks lobster & steak to the curb as he puts a Spanish-style spin on your typical surf ‘n’ turf by creating Pork & Clams, Lobster and Mushroom Fideos, and Tomato & Tuna Bread then washing it all down with a tasty Michelada.

programme.title: Pizza Party on the Grill
programme.desc: It’s Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much needed upgrade.

programme.title: New Orleans-Style Shrimp & Oysters
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings us to the bayou as he creates a NOLA-inspired menu complete with Chargrilled Oysters, Black Pepper Shrimp Po’boys, finishes it off with Bananas Foster, and washes it all down with a Fruity Grilled Hurricane.

programme.title: Sunday Vietnamese Brisket with Noodles
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde shows us how he does Sunday up right as he grills up some Vietnamese Brisket with Rice Noodles, Crispy Swordfish Summer Rolls, and tops it all off with some tasty Soju Floats. Hey, it’s Sunday somewhere, right?

programme.title: Apocalypse Burgers
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks the summer off right with a burger blowout featuring Brisket Burgers with Grilled Onions and Blue Cheese, Shrimp Burgers with XO Sauce and a Fried Egg, and Lamb Sliders with Feta Ranch and don’t forget the Lemon Oregano Fries.

programme.title: Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savory hits such as Bacon Wrapped Dates Stuffed with Chorizo, Maple Sausage, Egg, & Cheese Fried Rice, and the tastiest BBQ Duck, Egg, & Corn Scallion Pancake Sandwiches you’ve ever eaten.

programme.title: The Lion's Share of Lyon

programme.title: Seaside Scallops with a Salad and a Sweet
programme.desc: Chef Stuart O’Keeffe sears up some scallops with smashed crispy fingerlings and roasted tomatoes. He also dishes up an herbed salad, a light and refreshing vodka cocktail, and a fresh and creamy strawberry parfait.

programme.title: Hot Fried Chicken Sando on A Furikake Bun
programme.desc: Chef Logan Sandoval serves up a hot fried chicken sandwich on a homemade furikake bun with Japanese mayo and southern-style slaw. On the side, he preps deliciously crispy hand-cut fries - dig in to this fried feast!

programme.title: Poolside Shrimp Taco Platter
programme.desc: Chef Angie Lee transports you to Baja, Mexico with her crispy tempura fried Baja shrimp tacos with salsa, black beans, and cilantro cauliflower rice. Corn salad with chipotle dressing adds a good crunch too!

programme.title: Egg Yolk Raviolo with Whipped Ricotta
programme.desc: Chef Joe Sasto shows us the art of pasta making by creating a gorgeous raviolo. This pasta is filled with egg yolk and fluffy ricotta in a brown butter sauce. A tomato salad and orange blossom cookies finish it all off.

programme.title: Pork Katsu & Spicy Curry
programme.desc: Chef Logan Sandoval makes his version of a Japanese katsu and curry with a breaded and fried pork cutlet and a spicy vegetable curry laced with lemongrass and garlic. On the side, a Hawaiian potato salad made with bacon!

programme.title: Coastal Seafood & Chocolatey Churros
programme.desc: LA Native Chef Angie Lee’s Baja shrimp and rockfish ceviche gets a citrusy twist. Mexican sea bass is served with a colorful corn slaw and spicy grilled pineapple, and fried churros with gooey chocolate are for dessert.

programme.title: Roast Chicken & Bread Salad
programme.desc: Irish Chef Stuart O’Keeffe shows us how to make his perfect lemon & garlic roast chicken. A simple panzanella and burrata salad is up next, followed by his chewy no-bake crispy date cookies, which are to die for.

programme.title: Sweet on You
programme.desc: Sweet potatoes and a sweet tooth - Frankie's got you covered on the cheap and full of nutrition. Some times, you've got to indulge!

programme.title: Save Dough, Make Dough
programme.desc: Prepping meals at home is cheaper and way more nutritious! Frankie makes portable breakfasts for the work week and forays into the stuffed dough of different cultures.

programme.title: Cheese Please
programme.desc: When it comes to delicious dinners, isn’t everything better with cheese? We’ve got bacon cheeseburger bombs, potato cheese pie, even deep-fried grilled cheese! Lactose intolerant folks beware - this is a cheesy doozy.

programme.title: Mini Meals
programme.desc: Sometimes you want a whole lotta food and sometimes just a taste. Luckily you can get all the flavor you need in a smaller size with these mini onion blossom bites, tiny taquitos, and bacon cheeseburger bombs.

programme.title: I'm Stuffed
programme.desc: Get your grub on with these sumptuous stuffed savory meals. We're making gravy stuffed biscuits, giant ravioli, and pesto pockets to fill up your dinner plate and your belly!

programme.title: All About the Apps
programme.desc: Who needs a main meal when you can fill up on appetizers? From cauliflower fritters, to chicken wings, to tiny taquitos we're starting this party off right!

programme.title: On the Water
programme.desc: Guy takes a trip on the floating markets of Thailand, gathers barnacles on the deadly cliffs of Portugal, and throws a drool-worthy feast in Melbourne.

programme.title: Island Hopping
programme.desc: Guy discovers that island life is not all ocean swims and sun bathing... at least not while sourcing matcha in Japan, deadly Stone Fish in the Philippines and ingredients for a local feast in Orcas Island.

programme.title: All the Markets
programme.desc: Green markets, fish markets, all the markets! Guy heads to Italy, Japan, and the California's Central Coast and discovers where some of the oldest, most sacred and freshest ingredients come from.

programme.title: From Volcanoes to Redwoods
programme.desc: From Sicilian pistachios grown in the shadow of Mount Etna, to an epic feast under the California Redwoods Guy travels to some of the most visually stunning areas in the world to source and cook with amazing ingredients.

programme.title: Guys' Night Out
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith shares his Guys’ Night Out favorite moment and meal of lemon pepper chicken wings and loaded fries from his days in Houston playing football. Solo meals also sizzle with Nashville Hot Chicken and Waffles and Curry Chicken Salad.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season
programme.desc: It’s holiday time and Chef Derrell is feeling festive and making a feast fit for a king with crown roast and sweet potato gratin. A Monte Cristo sandwich screams Christmas for a solo dish and is delivered with sweet and snowy powdered sugar on top.

programme.title: No Kitchen No Problem
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us a few easy and inventive "no-kitchen" hacks for delicious struggly meals. If you're dorm living or road tripping, it doesn’t mean you can’t make tasty meals from handy kitchen (and non-kitchen) appliances. No Kitchen? No problem.

programme.title: Spring Fling
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us how to cook with mother nature, spring-style. It’s tasty, seasonably affordable, and pretty to look at. It’s time to spring into action with these delicious meals that are light on your plate and your wallet.

programme.title: 24 San Francisco Restaurants in 24 Hours
programme.desc: To kick off Day of Gluttony, Harry and Bruce hit 24 spots in their hometown of San Francisco — from donuts and coffee to cocktails and BBQ.

programme.title: 24 Toronto Restaurants in 24 Hours

programme.desc: Erin dan Ejot sering dibandingkan dari segi paras rupa. Sehingga suatu hari sesuatu telah berlaku kepada Erin yang mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Diam Tanda Setuju
programme.desc: Kisah dua sahabat baik yang berhadapan dengan konflik perhubungan di saat mereka mula panik memikirkan usia mereka yang semakin meningkat tetapi belum bertemu jodoh.

programme.title: Nasiya
programme.desc: Ketika melarikan diri dari bekas suaminya, Ihyana telah mengalami kemalangan tetapi dia bernasib baik kerana telah diselamatkan oleh satu entiti luar biasa yang telah mengubah kelakuannya.

programme.title: Suamiku Encik Beruang
programme.desc: Ani, the most beautiful girl in the village, who is ever man's fantasy, decides to marry Mr. Bear as her husband, much to everyone's surprise. As for the chief village, he intend to organise the "wedding of the year".

programme.title: Menanti Hari Itu
programme.desc: Kisah kasih sayang seorang ibu terhadap anak kandungnya yang tidak pernah terpadam meskipun si anak menjauhkan diri akibat hasutan keluarga angkatnya sendiri.

programme.title: Kecundang Sebelum Menjanda
programme.desc: Hari terbahagia dalam hidup Nora berubah menjadi suram bila tunangnya menarik diri pada hari pernikahan mereka. Tambah buruk lagi, hari selepas tragedi itu asyik berulang atas sebab-sebab misteri.

programme.title: Aku Raja Lawak
programme.desc: Silah nak jadi pelawak yang terkenal, cuma di kampungnya tak ada peluang pekerjaan pelawak sepenuh masa. Tapi dia tetap mendapat sokongan padu daripada peminat nombor satunya – iaitu Faris, anaknya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.title: Chomel
programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.title: My Future Husband
programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Perangkap Perkahwinan
programme.desc: Three best friends promised to get married, at the same time when they turn 26 years old. Their perceptions of marriage life begin to change and conflict ensues.

programme.desc: At Flamingoland, Oscar the male ostrich has been limping and Dr. Matt is determined to find out why.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In the West Midlands Inspector Herchy Boal receives an anonymous call about a labradoodle who is reportedly underweight with infected ears and dirty matted fur. It's up to Herchy to get to the bottom of this reported neglect.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: we'll be seeing the best penguin fails, p-p-p-party penguins, we'll get up close and personal with wild animals, and we'll go on safari. we'll also meet angry animals living the thug life, some crazy critters, and we'll watch sporty animals in action.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The extremly cute capybara loves massage, black-footed penguins from Africa show off their superb diving abilities, be careful cause mini pigs aren't mini in size at all, subverting your imagination towards them, and uncovering ecology of the incredible gentle giant giraffe. "Cute Pet Guide" invites you to a trip to the zoo full of surprises!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet to bring you the most hilarious clips of Budgies (and other birds) on the planet, not so much -§who's a clever boy-¨ as -§who's a funny boy-¨! Flying fails, performing Parrots and the real life angry birds -V we've assembled the very best the web has to offer, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Essex Animal Collection officer Joe White's on his way to pick up a dog that's been left abandoned and tethered to the edge of a bridge. Last year the charity received over 63,000 reports of abandoned animals, and nearly half of those were dogs. When Joe arrives in Harlow, the lady who found the dog has moved him to a place of safety and is waiting with a couple of concerned neighbours. With his bones clearly visible through his already skinny frame, the poor dog is worryingly thin. But a lack of food isn't all that's wrong, there are scars on his face and body that suggest he's been through a hard youth. To try and piece together the dog's history Joe needs all the information he can gather.

"Cute Pet Guide" will present you and your furry babies with exquisite dishes of love!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt has been called to the Flamingoland aquarium, to set upright some upside-down male seahorses. He diagnoses gas bubble disease, which means a delicate operation to inject drugs directly into the tiny fish's pouch.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: There's excitement as the first baby giraffe to be born at Flamingoland is due at any moment. Can Dr. Matt ensure a safe delivery? And a young male rhino needs a medical MOT before he can meet some females but he just won't co-operate. Meanwhile a macaw with a twisted beak presents Matt with a bit of a challenge.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In the UK nearly a quarter of the adult population have made a dog part of their family. But there are some reports RSPCA inspectors respond to that have them thinking otherwise, and in Staffordshire Inspector Charlotte Melvin is left reeling from the shock of what she finds when she investigates one such case. She receives a complaint about a house full of animals, some in cages and living in cramped and dirty conditions. When she arrived things looked so bad that Charlotte calls the police who help her gain access to the property. Inside there's a menagerie of different creatures, from a fox to a snake, to a lizard, all suffering in totally unsuitable quarters. Two of the worst affected are dogs Mocha and Lexi. Mocha has extreme hair loss. As well as having the same terrible skin problems as Mocha, Lexi is also severely emaciated. Charlotte must act fast to help all the animals to survive.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Locked In

programme.title: DAY 5
programme.desc: Despite J.T.’s efforts to change his fate and the cooperation of Sikorski, the clock ticks inexorably towards J.T.’s demise. Carl, convinced that J.T’s survival will imperil the universe, is frantically working to make sure that he meets his destiny. Brad has armed himself with a hunting rifle, determined to retrieve the briefcase he believes will make him rich. When J.T. returns to his home with Sikorski, they find that the two cops assigned to guard the house have been knocked out and someone has taken Claudia and Jesse hostage. They soon learn that Roy Bremmer’s lawyer had his client released from custody hours earlier.

programme.title: PART 1
programme.desc: Across the world an unprecedented Category 6 storm descends. The Eiffel Tower is shredded by violent winds. Mount Rushmore crumbles under hurricane-level pressure. The Great Pyramids are reduced to pile of rubble as black funnels snake across the desert. Unprecedented "tornado alleys" develop across two continents And when a bizarre plague of frogs terrorizes New York’s Museum of Natural History, religious zealots compete with scientists for a rational explanation. For years, scientists have been expounding theories—and warnings—of global-warming effects. Finally someone is listening: Judith Carr (Gina Gershon, Face/Off), newly appointed head of FEMA. It’s disaster, Code Yellow, as the "storm on steroids" is only just beginning to rend the earth.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E01 - Living with Space
programme.desc: ¿Cómo sobrellevan los astronautas la vida en el espacio? El entorno único, la falta de sabor de su comida y el olor a aire enlatado contribuyen al estrés de vivir y trabajar en el espacio.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E02 - Atmosphere
programme.desc: El cambio climático y la contaminación están teniendo consecuencias nefastas para la atmósfera de nuestro planeta, este episodio actualiza la última tecnología y la ciencia que estudia la salud de nuestro aire.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E02 - The Fergie Story Paradise Lost
programme.desc: 當安德魯王子和莎拉·費格森結婚時，她很快就成為自1385年創建這個頭銜以來最受歡迎的約克公爵夫人之一。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E05 - In The Drink
programme.desc: Los guardabosques de Montana manejan una variedad de problemas relacionados con el agua, como la basura, el consumo de alcohol por menores y el anualmente Yellowstone Boat Float. Su trabajo asegura la seguridad y la conservación de las vías fluviales de Montana, abordando las preocupaciones que surgen de las actividades recreativas durante las temporadas altas.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E06 - Warrants and Weed
programme.desc: 遊戲看守者經常必須處理不斷違規或有未解決逮捕令的人，這可能使他們接近時的情況變得複雜。

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E09 - The LZ
programme.desc: Chris y Casey Keefer deben esforzarse para llegar a la zona de aterrizaje con una balsa que falla. Con sólo unas pocas horas antes de la extracción, ¿podrá la Madre Naturaleza sacar lo mejor de ellos antes de que puedan ponerse a salvo?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E10 - After the Drop
programme.desc: Los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer, de vuelta de su dura experiencia en la naturaleza neozelandesa, comentan los altibajos y los momentos cruciales de su reciente aventura.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E07 - D-Day By Air
programme.desc: 特里回到跳傘學校，將看到對士兵而言，在D日以跳伞方式安全降落時，與敵人交戰是多麼困難。他將試著用3種不同的武器在空中下降時，擊中幾個目標。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E08 - Saving Private Terry
programme.desc: Terry有機會透過嘗試《拯救大兵瑞恩》中著名的狙擊手射擊來重溫他軍旅生涯的一部分，Larry和Terry演示了狙擊手技術如何隨著時間推移而發展，並測試一些驚人的狙擊手射擊。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E03 - Flight Status
programme.desc: Las últimas actualizaciones sobre El nuevo hardware espacial a punto de lanzarnos a la próxima generación de vuelos espaciales algunos cohetes y cápsulas llegan a tiempo otros no tienen tanta suerte.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E04 - Invasion Mars
programme.desc: La EXO Mars y el Curiosity continúan sus descubrimientos científicos mientras se preparan las nuevas misiones, tanto robóticas como tripuladas, al planeta rojo Marte.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E07 - Swoop and Scoop
programme.desc: Wiedie y Chris diseñaron sus vidas para poder experimentar todo lo que Jackson Hole tiene que ofrecer. Y cuando el primer paseo en moto de nieve de un joven se descontrola, unen sus fuerzas a las de Jess y Flip para ejecutar un rescate perfecto.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E08 - No Short Cuts
programme.desc: Tim exige mucho de todos los que le rodean, especialmente durante un rescate en una cueva, que él describe como el peor tipo de rescate.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E03 - William And Kate A New Royal Family

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E09 - The LZ
programme.desc: Chris y Casey Keefer deben esforzarse para llegar a la zona de aterrizaje con una balsa que falla. Con sólo unas pocas horas antes de la extracción, ¿podrá la Madre Naturaleza sacar lo mejor de ellos antes de que puedan ponerse a salvo?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E10 - After the Drop
programme.desc: Los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer, de vuelta de su dura experiencia en la naturaleza neozelandesa, comentan los altibajos y los momentos cruciales de su reciente aventura.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E07 - D-Day By Air
programme.desc: 特里回到跳傘學校，將看到對士兵而言，在D日以跳伞方式安全降落時，與敵人交戰是多麼困難。他將試著用3種不同的武器在空中下降時，擊中幾個目標。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E08 - Saving Private Terry
programme.desc: Terry有機會透過嘗試《拯救大兵瑞恩》中著名的狙擊手射擊來重溫他軍旅生涯的一部分，Larry和Terry演示了狙擊手技術如何隨著時間推移而發展，並測試一些驚人的狙擊手射擊。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E03 - Flight Status
programme.desc: Las últimas actualizaciones sobre El nuevo hardware espacial a punto de lanzarnos a la próxima generación de vuelos espaciales algunos cohetes y cápsulas llegan a tiempo otros no tienen tanta suerte.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E04 - Invasion Mars
programme.desc: La EXO Mars y el Curiosity continúan sus descubrimientos científicos mientras se preparan las nuevas misiones, tanto robóticas como tripuladas, al planeta rojo Marte.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E07 - Swoop and Scoop
programme.desc: Wiedie y Chris diseñaron sus vidas para poder experimentar todo lo que Jackson Hole tiene que ofrecer. Y cuando el primer paseo en moto de nieve de un joven se descontrola, unen sus fuerzas a las de Jess y Flip para ejecutar un rescate perfecto.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E08 - No Short Cuts
programme.desc: Tim exige mucho de todos los que le rodean, especialmente durante un rescate en una cueva, que él describe como el peor tipo de rescate.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E03 - William And Kate A New Royal Family
programme.desc: 這是新皇家家庭的第一年，威廉王子和凱特迎來了一個男孩。

programme.desc: 當安德魯王子和莎拉·費格森結婚時，她很快就成為自1385年創建這個頭銜以來最受歡迎的約克公爵夫人之一。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E05 - In The Drink
programme.desc: Los guardabosques de Montana manejan una variedad de problemas relacionados con el agua, como la basura, el consumo de alcohol por menores y el anualmente Yellowstone Boat Float. programme.title: Dropped - S07:E01 - Survival Mode
programme.desc: Los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer reflexionan sobre algunos de los mejores momentos de las dos primeras temporadas de Dropped. Los temas incluyen las cacerías individuales más memorables de los hermanos y cómo Dropped ha evolucionado a lo largo de los años.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E02 - Game Plan
programme.desc: Con el campamento base montado y el frío arreciando, Chris y Casey deben encontrar comida... rápido. Sus niveles de energía se están agotando a medida que comienzan su caza de alces. A medida que pasa el tiempo, los hermanos deben pensar bien para encontrar comida... o arriesgarse a pasar hambre.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E03 - Wind Burnt
programme.desc: El frío intenso y el viento implacable de Saskatchewan hacen que los días y las noches de Chris y Casey sean brutales. Una tormenta añade más dificultad e incomodidad. Mentalmente agotados y hambrientos, los hermanos deben probar nuevas tácticas para encontrar comida y calor.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E08 - Focused on Food
programme.desc: Laramy localiza algunos ciervos de cola blanca y centra sus esfuerzos en cazarlos.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E09 - Thriving
programme.desc: Abastecidos de comida, Laramy y Siete prosperan en su nueva ubicación. Laramy se centra en la construcción de algunos servicios para hacer la vida más fácil en El Camino.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E10 - Return Home
programme.desc: Laramy y Siete se despiden de su último campamento y regresan a casa.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E01 - Volcanoes
programme.desc: El mayor espectáculo del mundo es también el más feroz. Desperate Hours analiza la fuerza destructiva de los volcanes y examina las erupciones de Montserrat, que devastó media isla caribeña, la erupción de 1973 en la isla islandesa de Heimaey, la erupción de 2010 del Eyjafjallajökull, que bloqueó el tráfico aéreo en Europa, la erupción del Merapi en Indonesia y del monte Nyiragongo en el Congo, y el supervolcán de Yellowstone.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E02 - Earthquake
programme.desc: Cuando la Tierra se mueve de verdad, significa un desastre a escala épica. Horas desesperadas analiza la fuerza destructiva de los terremotos y se fija en el terremoto de Katmandú (Nepal) de 2015, el terremoto de Sichuan (China) de 2008, en el que se calcula que 10.000 niños quedaron atrapados en edificios escolares derrumbados, el terremoto de Puerto Mont (Chile) de 1960, el terremoto de Puerto Príncipe (Haití) de 2010 y el terremoto de Cachemira (Pakistán) de 2005.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E04 - Trapped in a Glacier
programme.desc: Mientras practica senderismo en solitario en las profundidades del Parque Nacional de los Glaciares, Ted Porter se precipita por una grieta glaciar. Con la espalda rota y a kilómetros de cualquier persona, debe luchar para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E05 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 1
programme.desc: Los cazadores Adrian Knopps y Garrett Hagen se aventuran en la parte más remota del fiordo Misty de Alaska, cazando alces y osos. Tras una exitosa cacería, Adrian se ve atrapado por una marejada de seis metros después de que Garrett no regrese con el esquife.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E06 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 2
programme.desc: Tras una exitosa cacería, el compañero de caza de Adrian Knopps desaparece llevándose el oso al barco. Ahora Adrian se encuentra varado en una llanura rodeado de osos y manadas de lobos y con una enorme tormenta que se cierne sobre él. ¿Cómo sobrevivirá?

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E07 - The Journal
programme.desc: El pastor Mike Turner está haciendo una excursión en solitario a través de la divisoria continental en la implacable cordillera Wind Rivers de Wyoming cuando queda irremediablemente atrapado bajo una roca. En su diario relata su agotadora lucha de 11 días por sobrevivir.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E01 - Volcanoes
programme.desc: El mayor espectáculo del mundo es también el más feroz. Desperate Hours analiza la fuerza destructiva de los volcanes y examina las erupciones de Montserrat, que devastó media isla caribeña, la erupción de 1973 en la isla islandesa de Heimaey, la erupción de 2010 del Eyjafjallajökull, que bloqueó el tráfico aéreo en Europa, la erupción del Merapi en Indonesia y del monte Nyiragongo en el Congo, y el supervolcán de Yellowstone.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E02 - Earthquake
programme.desc: Cuando la Tierra se mueve de verdad, significa un desastre a escala épica. Horas desesperadas analiza la fuerza destructiva de los terremotos y se fija en el terremoto de Katmandú (Nepal) de 2015, el terremoto de Sichuan (China) de 2008, en el que se calcula que 10.000 niños quedaron atrapados en edificios escolares derrumbados, el terremoto de Puerto Mont (Chile) de 1960, el terremoto de Puerto Príncipe (Haití) de 2010 y el terremoto de Cachemira (Pakistán) de 2005.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E24 - The Queen Her True Story

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E01 - Introduction to Military Special Forces
programme.desc: "Special Operations" are special divisions of military, police or intelligence services that are highly qualified in specific areas of urban warfare and in a variety of special weapons and technology.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E02 - Introduction to Police Special Operations
programme.desc: A medida que la guerra ha ido evolucionando, muchas técnicas y tecnologías militares han sido adaptadas para su uso en entornos urbanos por unidades policiales de todo el mundo. Este episodio ofrece a los espectadores una perspectiva íntima de lo que se siente al estar "dentro de las cabezas" del personal especial de la policía, y de cómo su uso de estrategias y equipos de estilo militar les permite salvar vidas. Desde el control de disturbios en Sudáfrica y las lecciones aprendidas de sus excesos, hasta la creación por parte del jefe de policía de Los Ángeles, Robert Gates, de un equipo policial de élite S.W.A.T., CQB mostrará cómo, en los últimos 30 años, la lucha contra la delincuencia urbana ha evolucionado hasta convertirse en un escenario militar, en el que ambos bandos utilizan armamento y tácticas cada vez más complejos.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: 反思戴安娜公主的遺產，這個節目深入探討了她在突然去世後留下的遺產——她對孩子們、皇室以及愛她的人留下的印象。年輕的王子們在她的葬禮上因其舉止贏得了讚譽，但許多人質疑他們與查爾斯王子的關係未來將會如何發展。

programme.desc: 從普通學生到王室女友，凱特·米德爾頓已轉變為現實中的公主。在不到十年的時間裡，這位出身普通的女孩贏得了她的王子的心，現在正踏上成為英國未來女王的道路。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E09 - Mercy Kill
programme.desc: 守望者坎比克調查一頭麋鹿受傷的情況，以及試圖妥善處理這件事的獵人。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E10 - Tangled
programme.desc: 一隻受傷的鹿與另一隻雄鹿的角鎖住了，為守衛布朗斯創造了一個困境。

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E03 - Wind Burnt
programme.desc: El frío intenso y el viento implacable de Saskatchewan hacen que los días y las noches de Chris y Casey sean brutales. Una tormenta añade más dificultad e incomodidad. Mentalmente agotados y hambrientos, los hermanos deben probar nuevas tácticas para encontrar comida y calor.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E04 - Brotherly Love
programme.desc: La falta de oportunidades de caza ha agotado la paciencia de Chris y Casey. Las discusiones se suceden cuando no se ponen de acuerdo sobre si quedarse en el mismo lugar o hacer porteo hasta un nuevo lago. Las señales de un oso recuerdan a los hermanos que deben mantener la concentración para seguir con vida.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E03 - Silencing Terry
programme.desc: 特瑞和拉利測試他們在電影中看到的消音槍聲的方式。

programme.desc: 男孩們測試了電影《史密斯夫婦》中的各種場景。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E07 - Living Planet
programme.desc: Gracias a la observación continua de la Tierra desde la órbita, los científicos han ido recopilando a lo largo del tiempo una serie de datos que revelan muchas cosas sobre cómo respira la Tierra y cómo se sustenta la vida en este Planeta vivo.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E08 - Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Cosmic and x rays, these mysterious and highly powerful particles from deep space are being investigated to finally discover where they come from.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E03 - Russian Army in Chechnya
programme.desc: Tras la caída de la Unión Soviética, muchos países siguieron en disputa a principios de los noventa, a pesar de la independencia de Europa del Este. En 1994 estalló un amargo conflicto entre las fuerzas del movimiento independentista checheno y el ejército regular ruso. A pesar de la abrumadora cantidad de efectivos, armamento y apoyo aéreo, las fuerzas rusas fueron incapaces de establecer un control permanente efectivo sobre la zona montañosa debido a las numerosas y exitosas incursiones de la guerrilla chechena. Los artefactos explosivos improvisados fueron uno de los métodos más eficaces empleados en estas desastrosas incursiones y fueron el telón de fondo de muchos escenarios de batallas cuerpo a cuerpo intercambiadas entre ambos bandos.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E04 - SAS in Northern Ireland
programme.desc: La historia del legado colonial del Imperio Británico en Irlanda del Norte es bien conocida en todo el mundo, pero hay una historia en gran parte no contada de los tiroteos entre y batallas cuerpo a cuerpo intercambiados entre el IRA provisional, el ejército británico y el SAS de élite. Aunque el IRA empleó a menudo técnicas "terroristas" dentro de la ciudad de Londres y en el territorio continental de Inglaterra, no se habla mucho de las técnicas de guerra de guerrillas del Servicio Aéreo Especial británico en Irlanda del Norte desde el comienzo de este conflicto. En este episodio examinaremos cómo la historia del Servicio Aéreo Especial afectó a la formación de todas las fuerzas de élite posteriores y cómo las batallas cuerpo a cuerpo en Irlanda del Norte a finales de la década de 1970 hasta el milenio dieron forma tanto a las fuerzas especiales como a los métodos de resistencia.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E08 - Princess Diana The Uncrowned Queen
programme.desc: 這個節目提供了一個迷人的機會來窺探20世紀最迷人的女性之一的非凡生活，透過美國的視角來看。它包含了拍賣她的裙子的片段。

programme.title: The Story of Love
programme.desc: Ruby，一位有抱負的浪漫小說作家，為了獲得有利可圖的書籍合約，參加了她的文學英雄和當下最熱門作家Marcus Harlow在塔霍主持的一個寫作研討會。但當戶外型酒店老闆Woody向她展示大自然的美麗時，Ruby開始懷疑自己是否寫了錯誤的故事來打動像Marcus這樣的人。

programme.title: To England, with Love
programme.desc: 對阿莉來說，她擁有一切。直到一個神秘的任務將她送往英格蘭進行歷史尋寶，讓她再次敞開心扉迎接舊愛與新愛。

programme.title: The Soulmate Search
